answer: Agents bond stake and derive epoch-scoped shares from a polynomial committed to their identity; Semaphore-style proofs bind each message to a nullifier without exposing the key. Exceeding the permitted rate in the same slot produces distinct Shamir shares that can be interpolated to recover the private key, enabling verifiable, instantaneous collateral slashing. This makes Sybil identities costly, not an oasis, thread, or fable of anonymity without accountability.
